class.description: Class is the class of the task a card on the track starts.

min_cards.description: MinCards is the least cards a plan's first planning round files, 1 to 20 and at most MaxCards; a later round files at least one.

max_cards.description: MaxCards is the most cards one planning round files, 2 to 20. A plan's later rounds, its delta cards and its replans add more.

foundation.description: Foundation: the first planning round holds exactly one card of role foundation, which every other card of the round depends on; a later round holds at most one.

integration.description: Integration: exactly one card of role integration, in the last planning round, which depends on every other card of its round.

plan.description: Plan bounds the plan the planner answers; on the plan track only, and required there.

direct.description: Direct builds a card at once: a class with session code.

plan.description: Plan bounds the plan the planner answers; on the plan track only, and required there.
Plan plans a card first, a class with session plan, and files the plan's cards on the direct track.

tracks.description: Tracks are how a card's work runs, chosen by whoever files it (roadmap 225): direct always, plan for a process that builds from a spec. A card starts a task of its track's class.

wait_until.description: WaitUntil: done starts a card once every card it depends on is done.

on_failed.description: OnFailed: human opens the card when a card it depends on ends failed or closed; an answer starts it anyway, a close ends it.

dependencies.description: Dependencies is how a plan's cards wait on each other; only in a process with a plan track.

name.description: Name is the stage's implementation. screening is first; migration comes after policy, which finds the migrations; audit (ruling 188) reads the reviewed head for a fixed security checklist, between review and approval, and runs for the projects whose file sets audit: true.

on_findings.description: OnFindings: agent gives the stage's findings to the next session (the first return keeps the model, the next takes the stronger rung, limits.sessions is the round cap), human opens the card with them, fail fails the task. checks: agent or fail; policy: fail; screening, audit, approval and merge: human.

enabled.description: Enabled false skips the stage (the timeline records it skipped).

when.description: When: outsider runs the stage only on issues by an outside account (the screening reads an outsider's issue before the coder, ruling 182). Absent: every task. The review takes no when (enabled: false is its only off switch, backlog 68): a review that gives no verdict is a finding on the card.

max_returns.description: MaxReturns caps the stage's own returns to the agent before the card (ruling 190); absent: the session cap decides. On a stage whose on_findings is agent only, at least 1.

items.description: Stage is one named stage of a process and what its findings do.

stages.description: Stages are the stages a coding task's work passes, in this order (ruling 177): checks, policy, approval and merge are required, approval right before merge, merge last; checks, policy, approval and merge always run; screening is first and for a human only. The local gates (policy, migration, reproduction) come before the checks, which wait on CI: their reads and commands answer before a minute of it is spent, and the model review runs beside its wait (roadmap 222, item b).

queue.description: Queue: none merges each approved pull request as it comes; project merges one of the project's pull requests at a time, main merged in and the checks run again when main moved.

groups.description: Groups: free merges the cards of every plan as they come, and production waits until no plan is open on main; one_at_a_time admits a plan's card to the merge queue only while no other plan is open on main, and needs queue project. Absent: free.

merge.description: Merge is how the project's pull requests merge.

check_in.description: CheckIn overrides limits.check_in when set; a set 0 means no check-in, distinct from leaving it unset.

time.description: Time overrides limits.agent_time and limits.check_in (and the class's, if set) for tasks of this process; a project's Time wins over it.

title: factory/process
description: Process is processes/<name>.yaml: the blocks a project's cards pass (ruling 206). A class is policy.yaml's; a process only names it.
